notes: Six own pages read with text (home, about, OEM partners, DMS, products, security), all HTTP 200 and not thin. The cited own page https://cloud.tekion.com/products/apc answered HTTP 403 (challenge) and is listed in needs_browser_read; it would bear on C09 (integration fees). Cause tracing: VendorMotive's roundup answered 429 (not retried); DealerInt's best-DMS page did not carry the statements; DealerSignals' Tekion review carries the Raj Sundararajan founder line (C15) and DealerInt's Tekion blog review carries 'formerly CTO of Tesla' (C13). Judgement calls: (1) C13 is wrong because the vendor's bio gives Jay Vijayan's Tesla title as Global CIO; (2) C27 (Azure) is true although the security page names Azure and AWS, so 'everything runs on Microsoft Azure' overstates exclusivity; (3) C17 (52 OEM brands) is unverifiable because the only count is '50 OEM brands' dated 2023, while C18 (50+) is true as a lower bound. 'Tekion Automotive Cloud' (C02) is a near-miss of the published name Automotive Retail Cloud and is unverifiable, not wrong. Hedged or out-of-scope lines not coded: '$640M+ in total funding at a $4B+ valuation' (funding, valuation), G2 ratings, '3,000 new features in 2025', '22% faster' deal desk, '20–35% lower than comparable CDK configurations' (comparison with another vendor), 'Reports suggest Tekion costs approximately ~$6,000/month' and 'A 3% annual increase cap has been reported' (hedged; the committed '$6,000' line in q7 Claude 1 is coded as C07), 'often cited around $4k–$8k per month' (hedged), named customers (Asbury, Ken Garff, American Motors Group) and lawsuits. The about page also states Tekion is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA; no answer made a headquarters claim. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot of https://cloud.tekion.com/products/apc exists in the manifest (it was requested in browser-reads.json but no browser row was recorded), so it stays in needs_browser_read and C09 stays unverifiable; no claim was re-classed. Consistency check: C13 (Tesla CTO) and C15 (founded by Raj Sundararajan) stay wrong; the about page states Jay Vijayan's prior Tesla role as 'Global CIO of Tesla Motors' and names the founders as Jay Vijayan and Guru Sankararaman, an explicit contradiction of the same fact. Completeness from comparison tables and sub-headed lines: new claim C30 '1,100+ dealership rooftops' (dealership-management-systems|q10|Claude|3), true as a lower bound against '3,000+ Dealerships Powered by Tekion'; two instances added to C29 (mobile use): dealership-management-systems|q6|Claude|3 and dealership-management-systems|q7|Google AI Mode|3 ('mobile-first' interface cell). Gap lines added nothing: they are comparisons with CDK, hedged price ranges (the 'often cited' $4k to $8k a month), lawsuits, feature descriptions, or repeats for answers already listed.
